LIVERPOOL. July 1.


Proclamation of His Majesty.—Yesterday His Majesty William IV was proclaimed in Liverpool. At an early hour the space in front of the Town Hall was filled with a large assemblage of persons, who waited to witness the ceremony at twelve o'clock. His Worship the Mayor, and other members of the Corporation, and the Town Clerk, William Strahan, Esq., proceeded in the usual manner to read the proclamation.
